risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Store.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty (cannot read games).
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: As a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: The controllers may be high-quality clones rather than Sony originals.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear sticker showing the FCC ID and model details.

risks.risk: The internal storage might be the base 500GB or a failing HDD.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: As having the minimum 500GB storage capacity.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened despite claims (missing warranty seals).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the console showing the tamper-evident stickers.
risks.if_unproven: As a refurbished or previously repaired unit.

response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is a PS4 Pro. It can be priced at its worst-case scenario (single unit, no games, unverified controllers, and potential repairs) until further proof is provided.
